_comment: Bear's scheme for a Figma pass aimed at remote part-time / consulting / educational-material work. Differences from default-0.1: (1) the director/VP exclusion is dropped — a 30-year teaching career legitimately reaches Head/Director-level education roles; only interns and early-career/new-grad titles are excluded; (2) max_skill_hits raised to 12 so a long, honest skill list is not clipped; (3) threshold raised to 4.0 to compensate; (4) location stays soft — Figma posts remote and US-hub roles.
